responsibility: Defines the search graph framework used by the trait solver to coordinate goal evaluation, cycle detection, provisional per-cycle caching, and final global-cache interaction. It exposes the context and delegate traits that parameterize solver behavior, tracks stack state and available recursion depth, drives fixpoint iteration for inductive and coinductive cycles, propagates ambiguity and overflow handling, and determines when evaluated goals may be inserted into or reused from caches without destabilizing results.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `solve/mod.rs`, which defines the solver’s query/result data model, this `mod.rs` implements the reusable execution engine for running those queries: stack-based goal evaluation, cycle classification, provisional/global caching, fixpoint reruns, and overflow handling. Unlike `data_structures/mod.rs`, it is solver-specific orchestration rather than generic support utilities.
